claim: MiniGraph/orama resumability is retained as an explicit R4 target. The canonical classification is: LangGraph checkpoint/thread identity ADOPT; atomic successful-boundary checkpoints ADOPT/ADAPT; durable resumability ADOPT R4 target; the phrase 'perfect resumption' REJECT WORDING ONLY; durable deterministic resume ADOPT TARGET. A wording correction must not be interpreted as feature deletion. The intended guarantee is deterministic continuation from an explicit compatible saved session/graph boundary with checkpoint lineage, graph/version/schema identity, replay policy, and effect identity/idempotency/dedupe. This is deliberately not total reversibility or time travel: graph-state restoration cannot erase external side effects that already occurred, which require idempotency, dedupe, compensation, or explicit human/policy handling. In reconciliation documents, distinguish feature disposition from wording disposition and treat deferred as not implemented in the current PR, not rejected.

decisions.notes: Direct operator clarification: be realistic but daring; reject only overbroad wording, never infer feature dropping when durable resumability remains an adopted target. Mirrored into orama-system PR #333 documentation.
